slots.title: Plenary discussion: How to explain, possibly mitigate, and live with model drift?
slots.people: Chairs: T. Penduff, S. Griffies (2026 example)
slots.description: Most ocean and climate model simulations using unassimilated primitive equation models exhibit spurious trends, also called numerical drifts. These spurious trends bias the final state of simulations and can hinder numerical studies of low-frequency variability and geophysical trends. This session will discuss the possible origins and consequences of these spurious trends, accepted practices for reducing them when possible, or for living with them.
